$schema_note: Copy this file to ~/.config/maestro/config.json (or to maestro.config.json beside the plugins, which is gitignored) and edit. Every field is optional; omitted fields fall back to safe built-in defaults. Nothing here is required for the plugins to load.

guardrail.$extraDenyRules_note: Universal catastrophic-op rules already ship in maestro-guardrail/data/denylist.json. Add YOUR OWN site-specific rules here. Each rule is { id, description, pattern (JS RegExp source), flags }. The examples below are commented-out patterns (as $example keys) you can copy into the real 'extraDenyRules' array and adapt to your own paths/hosts/containers.

$example_nas_delete.description: Destructive op against the NAS share or its host

$example_stop_media_container.description: Do not stop/remove critical media containers

$example_force_push_public.description: Never force-push over a specific public/protected origin

$example_protect_crash_fixes.description: Do not touch host crash-fix shims / held packages

brain.$note: Disabled by default. Point it at ANY HTTP memory endpoint to enable. It POSTs {content, region, source, topic} on SessionEnd for durable facts only, and dedupes via a GET ...?q= search first.

instinct.$note: Disabled and command-less by default. Set 'command' to an argv array of your learned-ops memory tool; the context string is appended as the final arg.

secrets.$note: maestro-secrets (plugin 6): blocks/redacts secret-shaped strings. Universal detectors ship as defaults; add your own patterns and an allowlist for deliberately-public values.

cost.$note: maestro-cost (plugin 7): appends one JSONL line per model call. Set per-model rates ($ per 1M tokens) to get cost estimates; unknown models cost 0.

rates.$note: USD per 1,000,000 tokens. Example rates only — set your own.
